ids.wiki: List of Berserk (1997 TV series) episodes

synopsis.en:
Guts, a man who will one day be known as the Black Swordsman, is a young traveling mercenary characterized by the large greatsword he carries. He accepts jobs that offer the most money, but he never stays with one group for long—until he encounters the Band of the Falcon. Ambushed after completing a job, Guts crushes many of its members in combat. Griffith, The Band of the Falcon's leader and founder, takes an interest in Guts and duels him. While the others are no match for Guts, Griffith defeats him in one blow.





Incapacitated and taken into the Band of the Falcon's camp to recover, Guts wakes up two days later. He confronts Griffith, and the two duel yet again, only this time with a condition: Guts will join the Band of the Falcon if he loses. Due to his fresh injuries, Guts loses the fight and is inducted by Griffith.





In three years' time, Guts has become one of the Band of the Falcon's commanders. On the battlefield, his combat prowess is second only to Griffith as he takes on large groups of enemies all on his own. With Guts' immense strength and Griffith's leadership, the Band of the Falcon dominate every battle they partake in. But something menacing lurks in the shadows, threatening to change Guts' life forever.
synopsis.zh: 身の丈を超える長大な剣を自在に操り、「使徒」と呼ばれる人外の化け物を屠る「黒い剣士」ガッツを主人公とする大河ファンタジー。ガッツはある宿命に憑りつかれて狂戦士のごとく大剣を振るい、闇に蠢く化物と死闘を繰り広げる。その目的は無為に殺された仲間たちの復讐と大切なものを護るということ。二つの重荷を背負い、5人の守護天使ゴッドハンドを探し求めるガッツはその下に従う人外の存在「使徒」との闘いの中で、運命に翻弄されつつも必死にあがく。

intro.logline: 同一段黄金时代，用 25 集慢慢讲：文戏、铺垫、人物关系都在这一版里。
intro.synopsis: 米德兰王国（Kingdom of Midland）与都铎帝国（Tudor Empire）的百年战争打到尾声。孤身佣兵格斯（Guts）除了手里那把比人还高的大剑什么都不信，直到他撞上佣兵团「鹰之团」（Band of the Hawk）和它的团长格里菲斯（Griffith）——一个出身平民、却打算用这支队伍换一个属于自己的国家的年轻人。格斯在决斗中败给他，成了鹰之团的突击队长，也第一次有了能称为同伴的人：女剑士卡思嘉（Casca）、飞刀手裘达（Judeau）、沉默的皮平（Pippin）、少年利凯特（Rickert）。鹰之团靠一场场胜仗从佣兵打进宫廷，而格斯开始想一个此前从未想过的问题：他挥剑，到底是为了谁的梦。第 1 集是时间线更靠后的倒叙，从第 2 集起进入正线。

characters.name: Guts
characters.role: 主角 · 佣兵剑士，鹰之团突击队长
characters.motivation: 从小在战场上长大，只把剑当作活下去的依凭；在鹰之团第一次尝到归属感，也第一次困惑自己是不是别人梦里的一把剑。

characters.name: Griffith
characters.motivation: 要一个属于自己的王国；为这个梦可以调动一切，包括同伴。随身带着一枚奇特的吊坠「贝黑莉特」（Behelit）。

characters.name: Casca
characters.role: 鹰之团队长 · 女剑士
characters.motivation: 被格里菲斯救出困境，把全部忠诚给了他；对半路进来的格斯抱有敌意。

characters.name: Judeau
characters.role: 鹰之团成员 · 飞刀手
characters.motivation: 什么都会一点、看人最透，团里的润滑剂。

characters.name: Rickert
characters.motivation: 团里年纪最小，崇拜格斯和格里菲斯。

characters.name: Corkus
characters.motivation: 嘴碎爱抱怨，从小队时期就在，看不惯格斯这个外来者。

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.motivation: 深宫里的公主，被格里菲斯吸引。

characters.name: Zodd
characters.motivation: 战场上流传三百年的传说，只对强者有兴趣。

highlights: 25 集的篇幅把人物铺垫铺满：卡思嘉的过往、格斯的童年、鹰之团日常，剧场版里被压掉的部分都在
平泽进（Susumu Hirasawa）配乐 + 片尾曲「Waiting So Long」，是很多人心里的动画原声天花板
画风厚重、分镜克制，靠停格和气氛而不是作画量撑场面，与 2022 版是两种审美
尺度比剧场版轻：血腥和性暴力都做了削减，蚀的部分尤其收敛
intro.standing: 1997 年 OLM 制作、NTV 播出，改编漫画第 1–13 卷（黑色剑士篇开头 + 黄金时代篇全部）。MAL 约 8.6、IMDb 约 8.6，在三个动画版本里口碑最高的一版。代价是作画时有崩坏、战斗靠静帧，删掉了骷髅骑士（Skull Knight）、黑犬骑士团（Wyald）、巴基拉卡（Bakiraka）等角色与支线，并且结尾停在原作第 13 卷，没有收束就结束了。评价共识是：想要故事和人物，看 97；想要作画和完整度，看 2022 剧场版重剪。
intro.route_note:
这部也不压缩：25 集约 10 小时，本版的价值恰恰在剧场版砍掉的文戏和铺垫，再桥接就等于把选它的理由删掉，所以全程 watch。分段只标节奏与版本接缝。

【双版本路线】以 97 为主力，2022 Memorial Edition 作补丁，三处接缝：
① 第 1 集是黑色剑士篇的倒叙，和黄金时代正线不连续，2022 版没有对应内容，可看可不看。
② 第 22 集营地被袭那段（绿色妖精带队的怪物）是 97 原创改写，原作对应的是黑犬骑士团（Wyald）一整条支线，动画两版都没有：看完第 22 集翻漫画第 10–11 卷。
③ 第 24–25 集的「蚀」受当年尺度与作画限制，删掉了骷髅骑士救场，结尾停在悬崖上：看完第 25 集后补 2022 版第 12–13 集（约 50 分钟）看完整版，再接漫画第 14 卷，那才是这段故事真正的收尾。

【两版进度对照】97 ep2–3 ≈ 2022 ep1；97 ep4–6 ≈ 2022 ep2；97 ep7–10 ≈ 2022 ep3；97 ep11–14 ≈ 2022 ep4–5；97 ep15–16 ≈ 2022 ep6；97 ep17–19 ≈ 2022 ep7–8；97 ep20–21 ≈ 2022 ep9；97 ep22 ≈ 2022 ep10；97 ep23 ≈ 2022 ep11；97 ep24–25 ≈ 2022 ep12–13。

【97 版专有名词差异】都铎方的追兵在 97 版叫蓝鲸重装骑兵团（Blue Whale Knights，原作为黑羊铁枪重骑兵团）；多尔多雷守将是总督加侬（Gennon）。

synopsis.en: A girl is being assaulted in a bar when Guts walks in. He kills all the assailants but one and orders him to tell his master, the Baron, that the Black Swordsman is coming. Guts later finds and kills the Baron, and removes a demonic relic called a Behelit from around his neck. Soon after, Guts remembers the events in his past of when he fought the knight Basuzo.
synopsis.zh: 铁匠正在铸造一把巨大的剑，而在他的身后站着一个只手只眼穿着黑衣的人。

notes.summary: 时间线靠后的倒叙。自称「黑色剑士」的格斯（Guts）闯进酒馆，杀光正在施暴的打手，只留一个活口让他给主子库卡城的男爵带话。随后格斯找到并杀死男爵，从他颈上取走一枚被称为贝黑莉特（Behelit）的邪物。事毕，他回想起多年前斩杀骑士巴兹索（Bazuso）的那一天——正线由此展开。

new.name: Guts
new.note: 主角，本集为其后期的「黑色剑士」形态

synopsis.en: In a flashback, Guts remembers when as a mercenary he killed the knight Basuzo. Later he encounters the group who would change his destiny: the Band of the Hawk. Corkus attempts to rob Guts and Griffith sends Casca to help him, but Guts defeats her. Guts then challenges Griffith, who grievously wounds him. Griffith orders Casca to lie with Guts during his convalescence. When Guts recovers days later, Griffith asks the swordsman to join his group but again he challenges Griffith to a sword fight.
synopsis.zh: 堡垒中发生了一场大战。攻击进行的很顺利，除了一件事——一位全身灰色的骑士挡在路上，声称没有人能越过他。

notes.summary: 回忆展开：佣兵格斯在攻城战中斩杀敌将巴兹索，战后遇上改变他一生的队伍——鹰之团。寇克斯（Corkus）想抢他的赏钱，格里菲斯（Griffith）派卡思嘉（Casca）出手，反被格斯击败。格斯转而挑战格里菲斯，被重创。格里菲斯让卡思嘉在他养伤期间照看他；数日后伤愈，格里菲斯邀他入团，格斯的回答是再打一场。

synopsis.en: Griffith defeats Guts, and makes him a member of the Band of the Hawk – an alliance between the philosopher and the berserker. The Hawks go on a midnight raid and Griffith chooses Guts for the most important position of rear guard; Guts succeeds and the band hails him as a hero.
synopsis.zh: 格斯与格里菲斯展开了剑斗。

notes.summary: 格里菲斯击败格斯，把他收入鹰之团——哲人与狂战士的结盟就此成立。夜袭作战中，格里菲斯把最吃重的殿后位置交给新人格斯，格斯完成任务，全团把他当英雄迎回。

synopsis.en: Guts settles in with the Band of the Hawk, and Griffith shows him his Behelit. Guts remembers his childhood, being raised by his adoptive father and mentor Gambino. The young Guts was forced to kill Gambino when he tried to kill the boy he blamed for his wife's death. Three years pass and the Band of the Hawk grow in power and numbers.
synopsis.zh: 格斯回忆起了他的童年。

notes.summary: 格斯渐渐融入鹰之团，格里菲斯把随身的贝黑莉特拿给他看。格斯回想起童年：被养父甘比诺（Gambino）在战场上捡回养大，后来甘比诺把妻子的死迁怒于他、动手要杀他，少年格斯被迫杀死了养父。三年过去，鹰之团壮大成一支可观的力量。

synopsis.en: Guts is now a commander in Griffith's army. Guts is taking risks in battle, and although he succeeds, Casca takes him to task for it. Eventually, Griffith is knighted as a viscount in the Midland court to the nobles' dismay. Guts saves the Hawks in battle, to Casca's chagrin.
synopsis.zh: 格斯现在是格里菲斯麾下的冲锋队长，在战斗中总是冲在最前，卡斯嘉指责他冲锋在前不顾队友。格里菲斯在米特兰宫廷被封为爵士，这让贵族们非常沮丧。

notes.summary: 格斯已是鹰之团的指挥官之一，作战方式冒进，虽屡屡奏效却被卡思嘉当面指责。格里菲斯在米德兰宫廷受封子爵，贵族们大为不满。战场上格斯再次救下陷入险境的鹰之团，卡思嘉心情更加复杂。

synopsis.en: Guts leads his men to raid a castle under Tudor occupation, but his men are wiped out by Nosferatu Zodd the Immortal, a fearsome giant monstrous warrior. Guts enters the castle keep and engages Zodd in battle. When Guts manages to stab him, Zodd transforms into his 300-year-old demon form. Zodd nearly kills Guts before Griffith and a group of Hawks comes to his aid, but they are ineffective. When Zodd is about to kill Griffith he sees the Behelit and ceases his attack. He then sprouts wings and flies off, telling Guts that should Griffith's dream die, it will be his doom.
synopsis.zh: 在一场突袭中，格斯与格里菲斯偶遇了一个名为不死者佐德的怪物。

notes.summary: 格斯率队突袭都铎军占据的城堡，部下被一个巨大的怪物战士——「不死者佐德」（Nosferatu Zodd）——屠戮殆尽。格斯在主塔与佐德交手，刺中他后，佐德现出三百年的魔物真身，几乎要了格斯的命。格里菲斯带人赶到也无济于事；佐德正要杀格里菲斯时看见了贝黑莉特，随即收手，生出双翼飞走，临走留下一句话：若格里菲斯的梦想破灭，等着格斯的将是厄运。

synopsis.en: Though he and Guts are still injured from their encounter with Nosferatu Zodd, Griffith uses it to get closer to the King and his daughter Charlotte. Guts and some of the Hawks feel that Griffith is pulling away from them.
synopsis.zh: 米特兰的夏洛特公主与格里菲斯建立起了友谊。

notes.summary: 格斯与格里菲斯都还带着佐德留下的伤，格里菲斯却借这场战功进一步接近国王和公主夏洛特（Charlotte）。格斯和几名老团员察觉到，格里菲斯正在离他们越来越远。

synopsis.en: Griffith and Guts continue to have success in battle and Griffith is made a count. The king's brother, General Julius, is furious about this as he and Minister Foss plot Griffith's murder with a poison arrow during an upcoming hunt.
synopsis.zh: 格斯和格里菲斯继续在战斗中取胜，格里菲斯被米特兰封为伯爵。

notes.summary: 鹰之团连战连捷，格里菲斯受封伯爵。国王之弟尤利乌斯将军（General Julius）对此暴怒，与佛斯大臣（Minister Foss）密谋在即将举行的狩猎上用毒箭取格里菲斯性命。

synopsis.en: During the hunt, Griffith and Charlotte grow close before the former is shot in the chest with a poisoned arrow. Luckily, Griffith's Behelit takes the arrow and he survives unscathed. Griffith deduces Julius to be the culprit and recruits Guts to secretly kill the noble.
synopsis.zh: 格里菲斯在一次猎狐中救了夏洛特，因为她的马受惊逃跑。而国王的弟弟尤里乌斯试图刺杀格里菲斯。

notes.summary: 狩猎途中格里菲斯与夏洛特愈发亲近，随即胸口中了一支毒箭——箭正好射在贝黑莉特上，他毫发无伤。格里菲斯推断幕后是尤利乌斯，把秘密除掉他的任务交给格斯。

synopsis.en: Guts assassinates Julius, but is emotionally scarred when forced to kill Julius' son Adonis to conceal the deed. Later, he hears Griffith tell Charlotte that he would consider a true friend to be his equal, someone with his own dreams and who follows his own path. Guts realises that although he is close to Griffith, he is not his friend.
synopsis.zh: 格里菲斯派格斯刺杀尤利乌斯，格斯在刺杀中错杀了尤利乌斯的儿子阿多尼斯。格里菲斯与夏洛特公主的关系越来越好。鹰之团受命去执行另一个任务。

notes.summary: 格斯杀死尤利乌斯，却为了灭口不得不连他的儿子阿多尼斯（Adonis）一并杀掉，心理留下重创。当晚他听见格里菲斯对夏洛特说：真正的朋友应当与他平等，有自己的梦、走自己的路。格斯由此明白，自己离格里菲斯再近，也不是他的朋友。

synopsis.en: Griffith and the Hawks lead the march into battle against the Blue Whale Knights. Casca has a fever, and after fighting with Adon Coborlwitz she falls unconscious off a cliff, Guts goes after her. They are washed downriver, and Guts finds a cave where he must keep Casca warm with his body.
synopsis.zh: 在一场暴风雨般的战斗中，格里菲斯的副手卡斯卡在与敌军领导人作战时受伤。格斯赶去救她，但当她在悬崖边昏倒时，格斯没能及时抓住她，两人掉进了悬崖下的河里。

notes.summary: 鹰之团出征迎战都铎的蓝鲸重装骑兵团（Blue Whale Knights）。发着高烧的卡思嘉与敌方指挥阿顿（Adon Coborlwitz）交手后昏厥坠崖，格斯纵身跟下。两人被冲到下游，格斯找到一处洞穴，用体温为失温的卡思嘉取暖。

new.name: Adon Coborlwitz
new.note: 都铎蓝鲸重装骑兵团指挥

synopsis.en: Guts tends to Casca but she still resents him. She tells her story of how Griffith helped her save herself from being raped, and give her a choice in life so she followed him. She watched him pragmatically go with a pederast lord to earn money to create his army and fulfill his dream. When Guts came, she knew that she would not be Griffith's chosen friend.
synopsis.zh: 卡斯嘉仍然没有醒来，当大雨倾盆而下的时候，格斯将她移进山洞里，她醒来后告诉了格斯她与格里菲斯的过去。

notes.summary: 格斯照顾着卡思嘉，她的敌意却没有消。她讲出自己的过往：少女时险遭强暴，是格里菲斯出手救下她、给了她自己做选择的机会，她从此追随他；也讲到格里菲斯为筹措军费，曾冷静地与一名好男色的领主周旋。她说，格斯出现之后，她就知道自己不会是格里菲斯选中的那个「朋友」。

new.name: Gennon
new.note: 都铎贵族，与格里菲斯的过往在本集被提及

synopsis.en: Adon Coborlwitz and his Blue Whale Knights find Guts and Casca. Though completely outnumbered, Guts tells Casca to run and stays to fight. Some men go after Casca, catching her and holding her down in order to rape her. Guts continues fighting.
synopsis.zh: 格斯和卡斯嘉试图在追击他们的敌军中杀出一条回归鹰之团的路。

notes.summary: 阿顿与蓝鲸骑士团追到两人藏身处。格斯让卡思嘉先走，自己留下断后，以一敌众。部分追兵追上卡思嘉并将她按倒意图施暴，另一边格斯仍在苦战。

synopsis.en: Guts eventually slays 100 men, including Adon's younger brother, Samson. Casca defeats her attackers too, and she and Guts end up back at the camp. Guts and Casca share a tender moment, where Guts explains that everyone in the camp has a dream but all he has is his sword, causing Casca to think he's leaving.
synopsis.zh: 卡斯嘉找到了捷德率领的鹰之团，并带领他们回到格斯独自战斗的地方。尽管格斯受了伤，他还是一人杀尽了敌军士兵。当他们回到鹰之团的驻地之后，卡斯嘉帮格斯处理了伤口。

notes.summary: 格斯最终斩杀近百人，其中包括阿顿的弟弟桑森（Samson）；卡思嘉也击退了施暴者，两人一同回到营地。篝火旁，格斯对卡思嘉说，这里每个人都有自己的梦，而他有的只是一把剑——卡思嘉听出他话里的去意。

synopsis.en: Griffith volunteers the Hawks to reclaim the impregnable Fortress of Doldrey from a Tudor governor named Gannon and the Purple Rhino Knights in his service. Guts learns that Griffith's unsavory history was with Gannon when he was a noble. The Hawks begin their assault before pulling back. Their boats are burned and there is nowhere to retreat to as the Tudor army leaves the fortress in pursuit.
synopsis.zh: 米特兰国王和他的将军们讨论了多尔多雷城堡，该城堡早已被楚丹帝国占领。格里菲斯计划发动袭击，尽管其他军官提出抗议，国王还是同意了格里菲斯的提议。只有一位将军支持格里菲斯的行动。鹰之团开始进攻多尔多雷。

notes.summary: 格里菲斯主动请缨，率鹰之团夺回被视为不可攻陷的多尔多雷要塞（Doldrey），守方是都铎总督加侬（Gennon）与其麾下紫犀骑士团。格斯得知格里菲斯当年与加侬之间那段不堪的往事。鹰之团先攻后撤，自烧战船断掉退路，都铎大军追出要塞。

synopsis.en: The retreat was a ruse and Casca takes the fortress, defeating Adon and the few remaining guards. Guts fights with the Rhino Knights' command Boscogn before his sword breaks, only to gain a sword that was provided by Zodd from a great distance. Guts uses the sword to kill Boscogn while Griffith kills a wounded Gannon to assure the Hawks' victory.
synopsis.zh: 在佐德的帮助下，格斯击破了多尔多雷的守卫。

notes.summary: 撤退是诱敌之计：卡思嘉率队拿下空虚的要塞、击败阿顿；格斯与紫犀骑士团统领波斯康（Boscogn）死战，佩剑折断之际，远处的佐德掷来一把巨剑，格斯用它斩杀波斯康。格里菲斯补上一刀杀死重伤的加侬，胜局落定。

synopsis.en: The Hawks' reclaiming of Doldrey marks the end of the Hundred-Year War between Midland and Tudor. The King holds a ball for the mercenaries in their honor. The Queen, Charlotte's stepmother and Julius's secret lover, hatches a scheme with Foss to poison Griffith during the banquet. However, before the event, Foss receives a disturbing letter. During the toast, Griffith falls to the floor.
synopsis.zh: 随着在多尔多雷的胜利，格里菲斯升为白凤将军。米特兰皇后和其他宫廷同谋试图毒死格里菲斯。

notes.summary: 多尔多雷之捷终结了米德兰与都铎的百年战争，国王为鹰之团设宴。王后——夏洛特的继母、尤利乌斯的情人——与佛斯密谋在宴席上毒杀格里菲斯。宴会前佛斯收到一封令他不安的信。祝酒时，格里菲斯倒地。

synopsis.en: The Queen and the conspirators believe they succeeded in poisoning Griffith and that he is dead. However, while they are celebrating, their room is locked and the tower is engulfed in flames. Griffith is still alive and watches them burn, having forced Foss to aid him by kidnapping his daughter. Griffith has again used Guts to remove his competition. Guts decides to leave and tells a pleading Casca that he does not want to be caught up in Griffith's dream anymore.
synopsis.zh: 格里菲斯为了复仇烧毁了皇后的城堡。

notes.summary: 阴谋者确信格里菲斯已死，正在庆祝时房门被反锁，整座塔被火吞没。格里菲斯安然无恙地看着他们烧死——他早已绑架佛斯的女儿，逼他倒戈。格斯意识到自己又一次被当成清理对手的工具，决定离团，并对挽留的卡思嘉说：他不想再被卷进格里菲斯的梦里。

synopsis.en: As Guts leaves, he is challenged by Griffith and manages to defeat him and earn his freedom. However, Guts' departure affects Griffith psychologically and he spends a night of passion with Charlotte in a lapse of judgement. When Griffith leaves the next morning, he is apprehended and arrested by the guards.
synopsis.zh: 格里菲斯不会让格斯简单地离开，他说格斯是属于他的。

notes.summary: 格斯离开时被格里菲斯拦下，两人以剑决胜负，格斯胜出，换得自由离去。格斯的离开击溃了格里菲斯的心防：当夜他与夏洛特共度一晚，翌日清晨走出寝宫时被卫兵当场逮捕。

synopsis.en: A year has passed and Guts is living with Godot, a swordsmith, and his granddaughter Erica. Guts learns that the Band of the Hawk are now wanted outlaws and Casca is their captain. Guts goes to them and finds them battling foreign mercenaries.
synopsis.zh: 格斯来到了铸剑工匠的家，在那里呆了一段时间，工匠为他制作了一把新剑。格斯在工匠小女儿的帮助下练习了更多的剑术。

notes.summary: 一年过去。格斯寄住在铸剑师戈多（Godot）和他孙女艾莉卡（Erica）那里。他得知鹰之团已被通缉、卡思嘉接任团长，赶去找他们时，正撞上鹰之团与外国佣兵交战。

synopsis.en: Guts helps the Hawks drive off the mercenaries. Casca has a plan to rescue Griffith from the Tower of Rebirth in the Wyndham Castle where he is being held. Casca blames Guts for Griffith's problems, but realizes it is not his fault. They make love and Guts asks her to go away with him after the rescue.
synopsis.zh: 格斯及时返回，将残余的鹰之团从毁灭中救了出来。

notes.summary: 格斯帮鹰之团击退佣兵。卡思嘉已经定下营救计划：格里菲斯被关在温德姆城（Wyndham）的再生之塔（Tower of Rebirth）。她先是把格里菲斯的处境迁怒于格斯，随后承认那不是他的错。两人结合，格斯约她救出格里菲斯之后一起离开。

synopsis.en: Casca and Guts go into the dungeon under the Tower of Rebirth to rescue Griffith, finding him mute, crippled and horribly disfigured from a year of seemingly endless torture. Meanwhile, the members of the Hawk are slaughtered at their camp by monsters led by a green fairy.
synopsis.zh: 在格斯的帮助下，卡斯嘉和鹰之团众人希望救援格里菲斯。

notes.summary: 格斯与卡思嘉潜入再生之塔的地牢，找到被折磨了整整一年的格里菲斯：不能说话、四肢残废、面目全非。与此同时，留在营地的鹰之团成员被一群怪物屠杀，领头的是一个绿色的妖精。（这段是 97 版的原创改写，原作对应的是黑犬骑士团一整条支线。）

new.name: Green fairy
new.note: 97 版原创，替代原作中的黑犬骑士团桥段

synopsis.en: Back at the camp, everyone is forlorn because of Griffith's terrible condition. The Raiders ask Guts to take them along with him. Casca feels she must take care of Griffith, and tells Guts to leave. Delirious and horrified at what he has been reduced to, Griffith takes off in a wagon and crashes into the river. He finds his Behelit and unintentionally activates it, taking everyone present to the Astral Realm.
synopsis.zh: 脱离了国王追击的军队，剩下的几个鹰之团队长在思考自己的未来。格斯安慰卡斯嘉，卡斯嘉对格里菲斯的情况感到沮丧。格里菲斯开始做梦。

notes.summary: 营地因格里菲斯的惨状陷入沉默。突击队的人请求跟着格斯走；卡思嘉决定留下照顾格里菲斯，让格斯离开。神志崩溃的格里菲斯独自驾着马车冲出营地，翻落河中，在那里找到了失落的贝黑莉特，并在无意中启动了它——在场所有人被拖入异界。

synopsis.en: The four archdemons of the God Hand awake and inform Griffith that he has been chosen to be their final member. For his baptism, Griffith must offer his friends as a sacrifice to the God Hand's Apostles. Griffith is shown visions of his past to convince him that the lives of his men are trivial in regard to the fulfillment of his dream. Guts climbs a mountain of flesh to try and stop Griffith from becoming a demon, but Griffith accepts the God Hand's offer. The entire Band of Hawk are branded as sacrificial offerings for the unborn child of darkness, Griffith.
synopsis.zh: 格里菲斯从小就被恶魔的承诺和梦想所诱惑，他同意实现自己的命运，成为神之手。

notes.summary: 神之手（God Hand）四位魔神苏醒，告知格里菲斯他被选为最后一位成员；受洗的条件，是把同伴献给使徒。他们向他展示过往的幻象，说服他相信部下的性命相对于他的梦想微不足道。格斯攀上血肉堆成的山想阻止他，格里菲斯接受了。全团被烙上献祭之印。

synopsis.en: The Apostles assume their true forms and commence the Eclipse feasting by devouring those branded as offerings. Griffith is reborn as the fifth God Hand, Femto, and rapes Casca in front of Guts. Guts is forced to cut off his left forearm to stop his former friend while his right eye is gouged out. A post-credits scene shows Guts in the physical world with his wounds healed as he leaves Godo's house to exact his revenge on Griffith and the Apostles ending the series on a cliffhanger.
synopsis.zh: 鹰之团众人被恶魔的欲望所牺牲。格斯继续战斗，一开始是为了拯救格里菲斯，然后是为了将自己从格里菲斯野心的结果中拯救出来。

notes.summary: 使徒们现出真身，开始吞食被烙印的祭品。格里菲斯转生为第五位神之手「费蒙多」（Femto），当着格斯的面侵犯卡思嘉；格斯砍下自己的左前臂想冲过去，仍被按住，右眼被剜出。片尾字幕后有一段：伤愈的格斯离开戈多家，踏上向格里菲斯复仇的路——全剧在这里戛然而止，没有收束。

new.name: Femto
new.note: 格里菲斯转生后的神之手之名

route.why: 黑色剑士篇的倒叙，时间线在整部黄金时代之后，用来定调。跳过不影响正线。
格斯入团、鹰之团成形，直到第 6 集撞上佐德——这一集定下了整个世界的规则，是全剧第一个转折。
战场转宫廷，格里菲斯的另一面开始显形。第 10 集是 IMDb 全剧最高分之一，也是格斯动摇的起点。
卡思嘉的过往和百人斩都在这里，全剧人物铺垫最厚的一段，2022 版把它压成了不到两集。
多尔多雷攻城战，鹰之团的军事巅峰，两集一气呵成。
宫廷阴谋、荣光顶点、然后是雪夜那场决斗。第 17–18 集的王后阴谋线 2022 版整段没有，只有这一版讲完整了。
一年之后重新开始的一段，三个人的关系在这里落到实处。看完第 22 集建议翻漫画第 10–11 卷。
终章三集，连着看、不要中断。看完之后再看 2022 版第 12–13 集补完整度，然后接漫画第 14 卷。
